restricted.title: Only the gym's owner manages business verification
restricted.body: The application and its documents are visible to the owner only.

body.not_started: Add your business details and a document, then submit them for review.
body.draft: Your draft is saved. Add at least one document and submit when you're ready.
body.submitted: SimpleFit's review team is checking your application. You can't change it while it's in review.
body.changes_requested: The review team asked for changes. Update your details or add documents, then submit again.
body.approved: SimpleFit's review team verified your business.
body.rejected: This application was not approved. You can start a new one.
body.revoked: The verification of your business was withdrawn. You can start a new application.

reasons.document_unreadable: A document could not be read. Upload a clearer copy.
reasons.document_missing: A document the review needs is missing.
reasons.document_mismatch: A document does not match the business details.
reasons.details_mismatch: The business details do not match the official records.
reasons.other: See the message from SimpleFit's review team.
reasons.business_not_verifiable: The business could not be verified from the information provided.
reasons.ineligible_business: This business is not eligible for verification.
reasons.suspected_fraud: The application raised a security concern.
reasons.business_closed: The business appears to be closed.
reasons.details_changed: The business details changed after approval.

documents.title: Documents
documents.lead: Upload a document that shows the business exists, such as a registry extract.
documents.limits: PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to {megabytes} MB. Up to {count} documents.

refusals.type: Choose a PDF, JPEG or PNG file.
refusals.size: Choose a file of up to {megabytes} MB.

submit.title: Submit for review
submit.body: SimpleFit's review team checks your details and documents. Submitting doesn't verify your gym by itself.

about.title: What verification means
about.review: A person on SimpleFit's review team checks that your business is real.
about.notPublish: It doesn't publish your gym or make it visible to anyone.
about.notPayments: It doesn't turn on payments or payouts.
about.notPlan: It doesn't change your SimpleFit plan.
about.privacy: Only SimpleFit's review team can open your documents. They are never shown on a public page.

problems.stale: Your application changed in another tab or on another device. The latest version is shown; check it and try again.
problems.frozen: This application can't be changed in its current state.
problems.uploadPending: A document is still uploading. Check or remove it before submitting.
problems.uploadMissing: The file didn't reach storage. Upload it again.
problems.uploadMismatch: The stored file doesn't match what was announced. Remove it and upload it again.
problems.documentSubmitted: A submitted document can't be removed.
problems.uploadFailed: The file couldn't be uploaded. Check your connection, then check the upload or remove it.
problems.limitReached: You've reached the maximum number of documents.
problems.storageUnavailable: Document storage is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
problems.limited: Too many changes. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
problems.limitedLater: Too many changes. Try again later.
problems.forbidden: Only the gym's owner can do this.
problems.gone: This item no longer exists. The latest version is shown.
problems.session: Your session ended. Sign in again.
problems.unknown: We couldn't confirm this action. The latest state is shown; try again if needed.
problems.loadFailed: We couldn't load the verification. Try again.
